error[ZC-E0124]: another zcube local command is running
  while  waiting for another zcube local command to finish
  cause  another zcube local command still held the lock after 0 s:
         <state>/local/lock
  fix    wait for the other zcube local command, then run this again
  more   zcube explain E0124
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0124.html
